content: Dispute DISP-002 filed by rider (no_show_charge). Gathering evidence...
no_show_check: driver_distance_from_pickup_m=0, driver_within_arrival_radius=true, arrived_minutes_vs_scheduled=-2, total_wait_min=8, contact_attempts=5, rider_replies=0
history_lookup: rider avg_rating=3.9, disputes=4 (1 upheld, 3 rejected), fraud_flags=1; driver avg_rating=4.9, disputes=1, fraud_flags=0

The fee should be reversed: the rider states they were at the Tiong Bahru Plaza lobby on time. The driver's chat messages only say "lobby area" without naming which lobby, and the mall has several. Evidence: chat_logs (driver messages), no_show_check.driver_within_arrival_radius. Clause: NS-1.7.

The rider's three rejected disputes and fraud flag concern late cancellations, a different issue from this no-show. Under the policy each dispute is judged on its own facts. Evidence: history_lookup.rider. Clause: NS-1.7.

The driver arrived 2 minutes before the scheduled pickup, 0 m from the pickup point, and waited 8 minutes, 3 beyond the 5-minute free wait. Evidence: no_show_check.driver_distance_from_pickup_m, arrived_minutes_vs_scheduled, total_wait_min. Clauses: NS-1.1, NS-1.2, NS-1.3, NS-1.4.

The driver made 5 contact attempts (messages and a 22-second call) and the rider replied to none. The rider also did not respond to the arrival notification. Evidence: no_show_check.contact_attempts, rider_replies. Clauses: NS-1.5, NS-1.6.

The rider concedes there is no rider-side evidence of a reply or of GPS presence at the pickup point. The case rests on the ambiguity of the pickup description. Evidence: no_show_check.rider_replies. Clause: NS-1.7.

Ruling: charge_upheld. Confidence 0.92. The driver arrived at the pickup point on time, waited beyond the 5-minute free wait and the 8-minute no-show threshold, and made 5 unanswered contact attempts. The $5.00 no-show fee stands. Clauses: NS-1.1, NS-1.2, NS-1.3, NS-1.4, NS-1.5, NS-1.6.
